name: app-exploded-ui-elements-house-chart-nav-chips-and-cards-on-white
title: Exploded Assistant UI on White
whatItIs: A white board with a central assistant card ('How can I help you today?' with chips and a gradient arc) surrounded by floating parts: a house-shaped chart of coloured blocks with percentages, a pill nav bar with a blue Home tab, category cards with letter tiles, toggle pills, insight rows with round coloured icons and letter circles.
whatItMeans: Pulling components apart and floating them shows the design system's pieces and its playful colour palette.
techniques: House-shaped block chart as a signature graphic
Components floated around a central card
Round coloured icons in insight rows
Warm palette of coral, yellow, blue and navy

vocabulary.definition: Interface parts separated and arranged around a hero.
A chart made of blocks whose areas show shares.
A coloured pill with a close or switch control.
